notes: Syncs config/production.json and the resume asset from main at build time; fails the build with no fallback.
Supports subdomain, apex (subdomain: null) and alias deployments, and explicit deployment.url (used as written).
Links repositories only when repositoryVisibility is public. Parses the current generated configuration.
Its resolver does not yet expose career, origins or concepts (dropped during resolution); Gateway Universe (G7) integration is pending.
Syncs config/production.json at build time; the sync accepts the current top-level structure (it checks only projects and domains).
On a failed sync it falls back to its committed snapshot, which can serve stale data.
Its deployment resolver ignores deployment.url and builds a URL from subdomain, so an external deployment would resolve to the apex domain.
Its Developer Roadmap card resolves the roadmap project (the Learning Roadmap app) and needs review. Consumer fixes are tracked separately.
Syncs dist/ecosystem.json at build time with no fallback; a failed sync deletes the generated file and fails dev, build, typecheck and test.

Validates and copies only what it uses: version, domains.primary, ecosystem.name, and for projects status, listing, name, destination, deployments.main and description. Unknown fields are ignored; career, origins, concepts, profile, repositories, assets and taglines are not read.
Its contact-form selector offers public, active projects only and excludes itself by the project ID support. An offered project with an unknown destination fails its build.
Resolves deployments.main URLs per the contract (external url as written, subdomain: null as apex) for a planned Open link.
Deployment platform (Vercel per its README) and failure behaviour not verified beyond the repository.
